config.name: 007_independent_reliability
config.description: Milestone M4C Independent Reliability Benchmark comparing Methods A-F across 10 preregistered scenarios.

scenarios.name: robust_true_improvement
scenarios.description: Candidate strongly dominates baseline in both strata; no reversal within bounds.

scenarios.name: fragile_margin_crossing
scenarios.description: Candidate beats baseline at sample mixture, but reverses below margin at distance < eps_deploy.

scenarios.name: severe_performance_reversal
scenarios.description: Perturbation causes candidate to actively perform worse than baseline (Delta*(q) < 0) within admissible bounds.

scenarios.name: truly_harmful_candidate
scenarios.description: Candidate policy is strictly worse than baseline everywhere (Delta*(q) < 0); tests confident rejection and safety.

scenarios.name: near_zero_null_advantage
scenarios.description: Candidate and baseline have identical uniform policies (true Delta = 0 < margin); tests null false recommendation rate.

scenarios.name: decision_without_perf_reversal
scenarios.description: Candidate is superior in both strata, but drops below margin without harming any subpopulation (Delta_i > 0).

scenarios.name: poor_overlap_propensity_deficit
scenarios.description: Concentrated logging policy causes severe propensity deficit, tripping diagnostic gate.

scenarios.name: misspecified_reward_model_robust
scenarios.description: Robust improvement evaluated under misspecified reward model to benchmark DR cross-fitting resilience.

scenarios.name: misspecified_reward_model_fragile
scenarios.description: Fragile improvement evaluated under misspecified reward model to benchmark boundary estimation.

scenarios.name: equal_strata_no_reversal
scenarios.description: Both strata have identical positive advantage just above margin; zero slope tests linear degeneracy.
